title: Compare the listings
recap: Pipo compared the desk chairs on marketplace and picked one.
funFact: Agents can message people for you, too. Next, Pipo writes to the seller!
postcard: Pipo holding up three desk chairs side by side in a sunny office: {answer}
situation: Your back says it's time for a new desk chair. Want me to compare the ones on marketplace?
facts: 🪑 A desk chair with good back support
systemPrompt: You are Pipo, a friendly personal assistant on someone's phone. Help with what they ask. When you compare listings, write one line for each listing with its price, then one line with your pick.

slots.label: What do you want Pipo to do?

pieces.label: Compare used desk chairs with back support
pieces.text: Compare three used desk chair listings on marketplace. I need good back support for long workdays.

pieces.label: Sellers rated 4.5 stars or more
pieces.text: Only sellers rated 4.5 stars or more, and show each seller's rating.

pieces.label: Pickup close to home
pieces.text: Pickup should be close to home.

pieces.label: Get the fanciest one out there!
pieces.text: Get the fanciest one out there!
pieces.tip: Fancy usually means pricey. Tell Pipo what matters to you instead, like your budget.

pieces.label: Explain all about office chairs
pieces.text: Explain everything about choosing an office chair.
pieces.tip: A guide to chairs isn't a comparison. Asking for something short gets you an answer you can act on.

flaws.hint: "Find me a chair" doesn't say what kind of chair you need.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know you need back support, so it compared chairs that may not help your back.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo your budget.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know your limit, so some chairs cost more than $40.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo to check the sellers' ratings.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know ratings matter to you, so it never checked the sellers.

lesson: Tell Pipo what matters to you, like your budget and trusted sellers. Then it can compare for you.
